datasets.name: AI City Challenge 2021 · Track 4
datasets.purpose: Roadside traffic clips with crash and stalled-vehicle anomaly labels.
datasets.limitation: Reference labels mark incident onset; they do not establish reliable pre-impact prediction.

datasets.name: Nexar Collision Prediction
datasets.purpose: Collision and near-miss clips with event timing for studying warning lead time.
datasets.limitation: Dashcam viewpoint differs from fixed roadside CCTV; attribution, privacy, and redistribution restrictions apply.

datasets.name: BDD100K
datasets.purpose: General road-scene inputs for road-user and lane perception.
datasets.limitation: Not an accident-anticipation dataset; the full video collection is very large (1.8 TB).
